# 1. Exotic Maritime Tribute Menagerie
oe_v495_fl.1 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_v495_fl.1.title
	desc = oe_v495_fl.1.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/institutions/global_trade.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		num_locations >= 2
		at_war = no
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_v495_fl_cd }
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_v495_fl_1_recent }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_v495_fl_cd value = 1 days = 540 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v495_fl_1_recent value = 1 days = 9125 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_player_global_flavor_cd value = 1 days = 240 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_v495_fl.1.a
		change_gold_effect = { scale = -1.5 }
		add_prestige = 8
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v495_fl_mod_imperial_menagerie years = 10 mode = replace }
		ai_chance = { base = 45 }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_v495_fl.1.b
		add_stability = 3
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v495_fl_mod_royal_jubilee years = 8 mode = replace }
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_v495_fl.1.c
		change_gold_effect = { scale = 2.0 }
		add_prestige = 3
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
	}
}
